About

Hi hi! I’m Phoebe, a UI/UX designer and Computer Science student at WashU who loves studying people and their habits to make things that improve a community or simply brighten someone’s day. Along with design, creativity is a constant flow in my everyday life, from the short-form videos I film for WashU’s official social accounts to the flyers I design for NSBE. You might also find me learning a hip hop dance in an empty classroom after hours, or turning the nearest object into the seed of my next novel idea. When the sun sets, I’m meditating and cozied up with a good book. If you want to talk all things design, or even want a book recommendation, I would love to connect!
